results.name: Lowpoly People + Waldo
results.description:
![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/pt9vSUA.jpg)
*Sample render in blender cycles: 10k particles - 2880x750 - 256 samples - ~7min on i7, 16gb RAM and GTX1060*

 

A collection of 282 (A.K.A more than you'll ever need) lowpoly people. Allright. Who cares. **Where is waldo?!**, that's the real question!

Automagically remeshing body scans to lowpoly assets (check out my growing collection of [free assets](https://skfb.ly/6yQSW)!), which can be used for archviz placeholders.

Each model has its origin located at its feet, so that placement in a scene is made easy. However, some refined scaling is probably needed as some children have become giants in the process...

Original scans from @FrancescoPusterla @fablabbudapestitseez3d @jc @my3dworld @justin.levitz @peel-3d.com @deathlessvr @myminimate @3DCap @onepoint @fwild @marpi @conjurer @thor3D @vitronic @3dhubs @codame @benhaim - all licensed under CC-attribution.

results.name: WIP - Lowpoly People - 1
results.description:
Trying out some remeshing scipts in blender/python on body scans! These ones come from the collection [Codame Labs] from @codame - all licensed under CC-attribution. As usual, feel free to re-use for nearly anything, and go check [my growing collection of free assets](https://skfb.ly/6yQSW) ;)

[There are more!](https://skfb.ly/6zqCE)

Each model is made of 1500 triangles, and has its origin located on the ground plane. Obviously, scans with multiple people have a lower precision.

I removed the textures to keep the faces as flat shaded, as this is the step I'm currently thinking about: geometry.
In particular, how to keep the characters nose - otherwise the face feels too flat - while remeshing in my (automated) workflow.

This could be done by specifying, with just one manual intervention (but not automated anymore!), the face as a zone of higher resolution and giving this input as a metric to [mmgs](http://mmgtools.org). Will think about it...

More to come soon as I make progress and if I feel inspired!

results.name: WIP - Lowpoly People - 2
results.description:
Still working on automated body scans (this time from @itseez3d) reprocessing. ( [There are more!](https://skfb.ly/6zqCE) )

The noses are still bothering me, and I fear I'll have to include a manual step in my scripted workflow to keep more geometry on the face than on the body.

1500 triangles models, 1024px albedo and normal maps. The model materials are from front to back: 

1. albedo + normal map
2. normal map only
3. smoothed normals (no albedo, no normal map)
4. flat shaded

As usual, feel free to re-use for any purpose under the CC-attribution rules, and stay tuned to [my lowpoly assets collection]( https://skfb.ly/6yXXZ ), as more will come soon!

results.name: Lion Crushing a Serpent
results.description:
Lion Crushing a Serpent (1832)
by Antoine-Louis Barye (1796 - 1875)

Although his contemporaries criticized his style and his choice of animal subjects, Barye is today esteemed as the founder of the Parisian animaliers.
The noble lion, representing the new King and the people of France, is shown in a triumphant struggle against the serpent, symbolizing Charles X (reigned 1824–1830) and the ousted Bourbon dynasty. The pair additionally suggests a celestial sanction for Louis-Philippe’s reign by alluding to the constellations of Leo (the lion) and Hydra (the sea serpent), which “ruled the heavens” during the days of the July Revolution (July 27-30, 1830).

![](http://rigsters.com/sketchfab_img/lion_preview.jpg)

The scanned sculpture is a copy made by Guy Hain, who is a French art forger who produced number of fake bronze sculptures.
The Lion is located by the entrance of Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek in Copenhagen.

results.name: Laocoon and His Sons
results.description:
In Virgil, Laocoön was a priest of Poseidon who was killed with both his sons after attempting to expose the ruse of the Trojan Horse by striking it with a spear. In Sophocles, on the other hand, he was a priest of Apollo, who should have been celibate but had married.

This particular sculpture was made by the unknown artist and is a copy of the original work. 

3D scanned using photogrammetry in Hans Tausens Park in Copenhagen. Capturing of the scupture was done by 4 people/4 cameras by jointly dancing around the sculpture.

 Reconstructed in Reality Capture from about 1000 images. 

![](http://rigsters.com/sketchfab_img/laocoon_3dscan-rigsters.jpg)

results.name: Rainbow morph animation
results.description:
This is a **free Blender resource** I created to encourage people who are just starting out with **3D animation**. The basic principles shown here have a wide range of potential uses, from game design, to scientific presentation.

Some of the concepts include:

* Rotation/translation using [Actions]
* Morphing using [Shape keys] & the Shrinkwrap modifier
* Texture mapping using [UV coordinates] & [Materials]
* Procedural texure animation using [Nodes]

For instance, I've animated some of my models to demonstrate:

* [**projection mapping**](https://skfb.ly/6SSBo): projecting a texture from a sphere onto an irregular asteroid surface
* [**timelapse evolution**](https://skfb.ly/6SzGJ): morphing through 3 scanned baking phases of a fruit tart
* [**fossil recovery**](https://skfb.ly/6V6GF): isolating and reconstructing a fractured dinosaur skull
* [**rigid body physics**](https://skfb.ly/6TYPM): simulating the accretion of an asteroid

Happy modelling / scanning & animating!

![](https://i.ibb.co/80R8L2f/img.png)

results.name: #5 - "Take it From the Top: Latin Rock" House
results.description:
Day #5 of my Everyday a Scan series!


This week, I’ll be concentrating on the many different districts of San Fransisco, CA.


This incredible house was captured in the Mission district of San Francisco, at the intersection of York St. and 25th. This entire neighborhood is filled with Murals left and right. Some on people's garage doors, some on the entire side of the building, and in this case, the entire house. 

This mural was done by a group called Precita Eyes Muralists, directed by Max Marttila and Fred Alvarado in collaboration with the Urban Youth Arts Program. 


Make sure you sound is turned out, the audio of the space really puts things into context.


Gear: 
- Sony a7rii
- DJI Mavic
- iPhone 7 (audio)
